requirements: Clinicians can upload patient datasets to train machine learning models for disease prediction
Data Scientists can compare the performance of different machine learning algorithms on the uploaded datasets
Patients can view their predicted health risks and recommendations for preventive care through a web-based frontend
Healthcare Administrators can access dashboards to monitor model performance and patient engagement with predictive insights
Researchers can download anonymized patient data with predicted outcomes for further study and model improvement
Clinicians can receive alerts when a patient's predicted health risk changes, allowing for timely interventions
Patients can provide feedback on the accuracy of their predicted health risks, which is used to retrain and improve the models
Data Scientists can integrate new machine learning algorithms into the system for comparison and potential deployment
The system must be able to process large patient datasets within 10 minutes to ensure timely predictions and updates
Predictive models must achieve an accuracy of at least 90% on the validation set to ensure reliable insights for clinicians and patients
The frontend must be accessible on a variety of devices, including tablets and smartphones, to accommodate different user preferences and settings
The system must comply with HIPAA regulations to protect patient data and ensure confidentiality
The comparison of machine learning algorithms must be performed within a 5% margin of error to ensure reliable and consistent results

risk_report.stage: Performance Testing

risk_report.stage: Security and Compliance Testing

risk_report.mitigation: Conduct comprehensive security testing, including penetration testing and compliance audits.

risk_report.stage: User Acceptance Testing

risk_report.stage: Model Retraining and Update

requirements: The Healthcare Provider actor can upload patient vitals data (e.g., blood pressure, glucose levels, heart rate) in CSV or JSON format for model training.
The Data Scientist actor can select and configure machine learning algorithms (e.g., Random Forest, XGBoost, Logistic Regression) for comparative analysis on patient data.
The System shall generate a comparative report showing performance metrics (e.g., accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score) for each ML algorithm tested on the patient dataset.
The Clinician actor can input a new patient's vitals and medical history to receive a real-time health risk prediction (e.g., diabetes, hypertension, cardiovascular risk).
The System shall display a visualization dashboard comparing predicted health risks across different ML models for the same patient input.
The Administrator actor can manage user roles (e.g., Healthcare Provider, Data Scientist, Clinician) and restrict access to sensitive patient data based on role permissions.
The System shall allow the Researcher actor to export prediction results and comparative analysis data in PDF or Excel format for further study.
The Patient actor can view their personal health risk predictions and historical trends through a secure web portal with role-based access control.
All patient data processing must comply with HIPAA regulations, ensuring encryption of data in transit and at rest with AES-256 or equivalent.
The system must process and return health risk predictions within 2 seconds to ensure real-time usability for clinicians during patient consultations.
The comparative ML analysis report must be generated within 10 seconds for datasets containing up to 100,000 patient records.
The frontend interface must support responsive design for tablets and mobile devices used by clinicians in clinical settings with touch-friendly controls.
The system shall log all prediction requests and model comparisons for audit purposes, retaining logs for a minimum of 7 years to meet healthcare compliance standards.

risk_report.stage: Gather detailed requirements and create user stories
risk_report.risk: Incomplete or ambiguous requirements may lead to scope creep or misaligned deliverables.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct stakeholder workshops and sign-off on detailed requirements before proceeding.

risk_report.stage: Design system architecture and high-level design
risk_report.risk: Overly complex architecture may introduce unnecessary technical debt or scalability issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Adopt a modular design approach with clear separation of concerns and documented trade-offs.

risk_report.stage: Design database schema and HIPAA-compliant data model
risk_report.risk: Poor schema design may lead to data integrity issues or compliance violations.
risk_report.mitigation: Engage a data architect with HIPAA experience and validate schema with stakeholders.

risk_report.stage: Design API specifications and microservices boundaries
risk_report.risk: Tight coupling between microservices may hinder scalability or independent deployments.
risk_report.mitigation: Define clear API contracts and enforce loose coupling through event-driven architecture.

risk_report.stage: Design frontend UI/UX including responsive dashboard and mobile support
risk_report.risk: Inconsistent UX across devices may frustrate users and reduce adoption.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct usability testing early with diverse device mockups and user feedback.

risk_report.stage: Set up development environment and CI/CD pipeline
risk_report.risk: Misconfigured CI/CD may lead to deployment failures or security vulnerabilities.
risk_report.mitigation: Use infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and automated security scanning in the pipeline.

risk_report.stage: Implement user authentication and role-based access control (RBAC)
risk_report.risk: Weak authentication or RBAC flaws may expose sensitive health data.
risk_report.mitigation: Use industry-standard frameworks (e.g., OAuth2, OpenID Connect) and conduct penetration testing.

risk_report.stage: Implement data encryption (AES-256) for data in transit and at rest
risk_report.risk: Improper key management or encryption implementation may lead to data breaches.
risk_report.mitigation: Follow NIST guidelines for key management and validate encryption with third-party audits.

risk_report.stage: Implement Healthcare Provider module for uploading patient vitals (CSV/JSON)
risk_report.risk: Poor data validation may corrupt patient records or trigger incorrect predictions.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement strict schema validation and automated testing for data ingestion.

risk_report.stage: Implement Data Scientist module for ML algorithm selection and configuration
risk_report.risk: Incorrect algorithm selection or configuration may produce unreliable predictions.
risk_report.mitigation: Establish a peer review process for algorithm selection and validate with historical data.

risk_report.stage: Implement ML model training and comparative analysis engine
risk_report.risk: Poor model training may lead to biased or inaccurate predictions.
risk_report.mitigation: Use cross-validation, bias detection, and continuous monitoring of model performance.

risk_report.stage: Implement Clinician module for real-time health risk prediction input and display
risk_report.risk: Latency in real-time predictions may delay critical clinical decisions.
risk_report.mitigation: Optimize model inference and implement caching for frequent queries.

risk_report.stage: Implement visualization dashboard for predicted health risks across models
risk_report.risk: Poor dashboard design may mislead clinicians or obscure critical trends.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct iterative usability testing with clinicians to refine visualization designs.

risk_report.stage: Implement Administrator module for user role and access management
risk_report.risk: Privilege escalation or misconfigured roles may compromise system security.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement least-privilege access and conduct regular access reviews.

risk_report.stage: Implement Researcher module for exporting prediction and analysis data (PDF/Excel)
risk_report.risk: Data leaks during export may violate HIPAA or patient privacy.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement strict access controls and audit trails for all export operations.

risk_report.stage: Implement Patient portal for viewing personal predictions and trends
risk_report.risk: Poor data presentation may confuse patients or lead to misinterpretation of risks.
risk_report.mitigation: Use patient-friendly language and validate designs with focus groups.

risk_report.stage: Implement audit logging system for prediction requests and model comparisons
risk_report.risk: Incomplete or tampered logs may hinder compliance investigations.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement immutable logs with cryptographic integrity checks and regular audits.

risk_report.stage: Unit test all modules and services
risk_report.risk: Insufficient test coverage may allow undetected bugs to reach production.
risk_report.mitigation: Enforce minimum test coverage thresholds and integrate testing into CI/CD.

risk_report.stage: Perform integration testing across all modules and APIs
risk_report.risk: Undetected integration issues may cause system-wide failures in production.
risk_report.mitigation: Use contract testing and staged rollouts to validate integrations.

risk_report.stage: Conduct performance testing for real-time prediction (<2s) and report generation (<10s)
risk_report.risk: Performance bottlenecks may degrade user experience or violate SLAs.
risk_report.mitigation: Profile bottlenecks early and optimize critical paths with load testing.

risk_report.stage: Conduct security and HIPAA compliance testing
risk_report.risk: Undetected vulnerabilities may lead to data breaches or regulatory penalties.
risk_report.mitigation: Engage third-party security experts for penetration testing and HIPAA audits.

risk_report.stage: Conduct usability testing for responsive design on tablets and mobile devices
risk_report.risk: Poor mobile UX may reduce adoption among clinicians or patients.
risk_report.mitigation: Test on a variety of devices and gather feedback from end-users.

risk_report.stage: Deploy system to staging environment with anonymized test data
risk_report.risk: Staging environment may not accurately reflect production, leading to undetected issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Ensure staging mirrors production in configuration and data volume.

risk_report.stage: Conduct user acceptance testing (UAT) with stakeholders
risk_report.risk: Stakeholders may reject the system due to misaligned expectations.
risk_report.mitigation: Involve stakeholders early in the process and document acceptance criteria.

risk_report.stage: Finalize documentation (technical, user, compliance)
risk_report.risk: Outdated or incomplete documentation may hinder maintenance or compliance audits.
risk_report.mitigation: Assign a dedicated documentation owner and automate documentation generation where possible.

risk_report.stage: Deploy system to production with HIPAA-compliant infrastructure
risk_report.risk: Deployment errors may cause downtime or data loss in production.
risk_report.mitigation: Use blue-green deployments and rollback plans with automated health checks.

risk_report.stage: Monitor system performance and conduct post-deployment validation
risk_report.risk: Undetected performance degradation or errors may go unaddressed.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement real-time monitoring with alerts and scheduled validation checks.
